authoritative_bridge_contract.official_dataset: National Polygon Service plus Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset
authoritative_bridge_contract.sample_scope: Bristol 5km2 sample only; not proven to cover gas_emissions_2 Enfield partition rows

decision_reason: Official HM Land Registry documentation proves the deterministic bridge INSPIRE polygon -> title number -> UPRN exists only in the licensed, chargeable National Polygon Service. The current open INSPIRE dataset exposes an INSPIRE ID and indicative geometry but not the title-number/UPRN bridge. No exact open parcel-to-UPRN/TOID input, exact polygon input, or EPC bearer token is present.

source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: HM Land Registry states that it will expand the use of UPRNs across more published datasets and introduce spatial identifiers such as INSPIRE IDs into more free datasets. This is future-plan evidence, not a current open mapping release.
The API lists nps and nps_sample datasets. A 403 response occurs when an API key is missing, the dataset licence has not been agreed, or the user does not have access to a paid dataset.

Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID that relates to a registered title. The open dataset provides indicative freehold polygons under the Open Government Licence; the extent of a registered title cannot be established from the INSPIRE polygon alone.

National Polygon records include Shape, Poly_ID, and Title_No. The title number links National Polygon records to the UPRN dataset. INSPIRE Index Polygons are a subset with simpler attributes: identifier, create date, and last updated date.

The National Polygon Service contains the National Polygon dataset, Title Descriptor dataset, and Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset. The datasets are licensed and chargeable. The service costs £20,000 per year plus VAT; access requires an account, licence agreement, and payment. API access requires an API key after licence and payment.

The Title Number/UPRN Look Up Dataset contains HM Land Registry title numbers and Ordnance Survey AddressBase UPRNs. Its mandatory fields are Title_No and UPRN. Access is chargeable and requires an account, licence, and payment.
